MASTER-SAAO robotic telescope  [1]  located in South Africa (South African Astronomical Observatory) was pointed to the SVOM sb26071506 ( SVOM_group <svomgroup@bao.ac.cn> et al., GCN 45169) errorbox  273 sec after notice time and 2918 sec after trigger time at 2026-07-15 17:11:42 UT, with upper limit up to  18.1 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 79 deg. The sun  altitude  is -17.5 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -37 deg., longitude l = 12 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3429400

We obtain a following upper limits.
